# T1. Dispersion sensitivity of the proposed-model margins and PBE ordering errors of reference polymorphs

Quantum ESPRESSO, 80 Ry k-spacing 0.22, 0 K, no SOC, meV/atom. Part A: negative = proposed model below the reference. Part B: energy of the experimentally observed polymorph minus the polymorph the method ranks lower; positive = wrong order. Predicted, proposed models; not an experimental claim.

**A. Margin of the proposed model (negative = TP lower)**

| Quantity | PBE-D3 (zero damping) | PBE-D3(BJ) | PBE (no D3) |
|---|---|---|---|
| TP-NaSbBr4-01 vs NaBr + lowest computed SbBr3 | -6.16 | -7.04 | -10.72 |
| TP-NaSbBr4-01 vs lowest listed NaSbBr4 (agm003733885) | -17.02 | -21.59 | -21.84 |
| TP-LiSbBr4-01 vs LiBr + SbBr3 (lowest LiBr computed in each column) | -7.66 | -8.42 | +2.05 |
| TP-LiSbBr4-01 vs LiBr rocksalt (agm003157564) + SbBr3 | -7.97 | -8.42 | -7.42 |
| TP-LiSbBr4-01 vs LiBr wurtzite (agm002091979) + SbBr3 | -7.66 | -14.42 | +2.05 |
| TP-LiSbBr4-01 vs lowest listed LiSbBr4 (agm005739369) | -23.28 | -22.71 | -22.67 |

**B. Polymorph-ordering error of the method (positive = wrong order)**

| Quantity | PBE-D3 (zero damping) | PBE-D3(BJ) | PBE (no D3) |
|---|---|---|---|
| SbBr3: Pnma (expt, agm003218591) minus R-3 (agm002139075) | +15.15 | +26.13 | +20.60 |
| LiBr: rocksalt (expt, agm003157564) minus wurtzite (agm002091979) | +0.94 | -17.99 | +28.39 |
